name: electron-blocks
description: Timeblocks desktop shell — loads the react-web-calendar build in the main process

scripts.sync:web: npm run build:web && rm -rf web-build && cp -R ../react-web-calendar/build web-build
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --win --x64
